themes.zen:
Use case: style-transfer. Input image is the approved original SPACE café composition. Create ONE new theme variant for the same owner's personal café website. Preserve the exact wide 16:9 camera position, perspective, the café counter zone on the left, the reading seats in the middle, expansive outdoor view through glazing, and most importantly the owner's silver desktop computer, keyboard, coffee cup and notebook on the near-right foreground desk. Keep the computer screen in approximately the same right-center rectangle and readable exact wordmark "CUBXXW OS", no desktop shortcut icons. Keep "SPACE" as the only other lettering, tastefully integrated on the counter wall. Transform the café interior architecture, materials, planting, light, atmosphere AND exterior scenery to the specified theme, so each is a complete beautiful café, not just a swapped wallpaper. An intimate, personally owned, exceptionally composed and realistically plausible future café with discreet technology and human warmth. Photoreal architectural visualization, fine material textures, natural optical depth, beautiful clean composition. No people, no fake webpage UI, no overlays, no watermark, no floating holograms. Keep this a SINGLE continuous wide scene.
Theme: JAPANESE ZEN COURTYARD. My ideal most beautiful quiet café: rain-cleared maple leaves, a meticulously composed intimate moss-and-stone garden, fine gravel, a shallow reflecting water basin, the sound of water suggested visually, a simple garden wall and a restrained timber pavilion beyond. Interior uses pale Japanese oak, clean timber framing, soft mineral plaster, subtly textured stone, a few simple ceramic pieces, and subdued green linen chairs. Soft cool morning daylight through broad glass, balanced by intimate warm lamps. Still clearly a contemporary coffee shop with a small professional espresso counter. Give the scene contemplative generosity and exceptional refinement. Avoid tourist clichés, torii gates, shrine symbols, excessive tatami and ornamental clutter. The computer's wallpaper echoes this quiet courtyard.

Theme: CONTEMPORARY CHINESE SCHOLAR'S GARDEN CAFÉ. A refined Jiangnan courtyard reinterpretation, white garden walls, dark timber, a softly framed moon gate visible outside, carefully arranged scholar rocks, bamboo and a tranquil pond with delicate plants. Interior has restrained Ming-inspired wood furniture, mineral plaster, pale stone and small handmade ceramic details, with a modern coffee counter and espresso machine. Soft dappled late-morning light, rich foliage, layered borrowed views through an elegant broad opening with sparse timber framing. Calm, cultured, poetic and genuinely beautiful. No red lantern clichés, dragons, pagodas, imperial décor or generic mixing with Japanese design. The computer's wallpaper echoes the Chinese courtyard pond.

Theme: QUIET OCEANFRONT CAFÉ. An extraordinary small café overlooking a sandy beach and an immense blue sea, restrained coastal architecture with lime plaster, light weathered oak, soft linen, brushed metal, dune grasses and a few sculptural plants. Golden late-afternoon light, gentle white surf, a timber outdoor terrace and comfortable outdoor chairs just beyond the glazing. The room feels airy, personal and tactile rather than a resort lobby. Preserve the real café counter and owner's dedicated computer place. The computer wallpaper echoes the sea and sky. The feeling is being able to work and think for an afternoon with the ocean nearby.

Theme: MOUNTAIN RETREAT CAFÉ. A beautiful timber-and-stone café overlooking a broad alpine valley with layered peaks, pine forest, a low ribbon of morning cloud, distant dramatic mountain ridges and a grassy terrace. Warm larch/oak framing, understated grey natural stone, wool-textured green chairs, fine joinery and warm practical lamps. Clear fresh mountain morning with sunlight grazing the personal desk and long gentle shadows, warm interior against crisp blue-green peaks. This is an intimate coffee shop for a thoughtful travelling builder, not a ski resort or luxury hotel. The computer's wallpaper echoes the mountain valley.

Theme: RAINY NIGHT BOOK CAFÉ. A deeply inviting urban book café at blue hour after rain, with an outdoor garden terrace facing a quiet tree-lined street, warm lights reflected on wet stone, visible fine rain on the broad glass, and a dark blue atmospheric sky. Interior becomes a sophisticated private-feeling literary café with tall timber bookshelves, deep green fabric, a wood-and-stone espresso counter, warm reading lamps, and finely controlled amber light. Owner's computer remains on the near-right desk beside coffee and notebook, a calm glowing screen with 'CUBXXW OS'. Rich warm/cool balance, believable light sources, rain texture and layered depth, never noir gloom or cyberpunk neon. The computer's wallpaper echoes the rainy garden at dusk.
